videos.headline: Arizona State gets INT off deflection
videos.description: Utah QB Tyler Huntley is intercepted by J'Marcus Rhodes, who returns it to the Utah 28-yard line.

videos.headline: Utah QB gains 1st down after 15-yard dash
videos.description: Tyler Huntley sprints right and dives toward the first down marker to get the first down.

videos.headline: Arizona State's 1-yard TD run gives them first TD of game
videos.description: Demario Richardson takes the handoff from one-yard out for the touchdown.

videos.headline: Arizona State QB's TD run pads lead
videos.description: Arizona State QB Manny Wilkins rolls right and dives into the end zone for the touchdown giving them a 23-3 lead.

videos.headline: Utah's rush TD is first of day
videos.description: Utah RB Devonta'e Henry-Cole takes the handoff from 2-yards out into the end zone for the touchdown.

videos.headline: Arizona State gets third INT of game on bad screen pass
videos.description: Utah QB Tyler Huntley is intercepted by Christian Sam and returned 11 yards to the Utah 31-yard line.

videos.headline: Utah collects first turnover on INT
videos.description: Arizona State QB Manny Wilkins' pass is intercepted by Kavika Luafatasaga at the Utah 30-yard line.

videos.headline: Ballage breaks loose for 35-yard gain
videos.description: Arizona State RB Kalen Ballage gets the handoff and rushes 35 yards, moving them in Utah territory.
